purpose: Character parts for articulated pixel animation
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art cutout parts atlas for a four-direction articulated 2D RPG character.
Input 1 is Elías's identity reference. Input 2 is the existing tiny game sprite reference; preserve its mature JRPG proportions, costume and palette.
Create a TRANSPARENT PNG sprite-part sheet, exactly EIGHT equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 32 isolated parts, one part centered in each cell, generous clear margins. This is a separated animation rig kit, NOT full characters or animation poses. No labels, numbers, text, borders, shadows or scenery.
Rows, top to bottom: SOUTH/front looking at viewer; WEST/profile facing LEFT; EAST/profile facing RIGHT; NORTH/back facing away. Each row shows the SAME eight parts in that viewing direction.
Columns left to right:
1. complete golden blond HEAD including hair, face and short neck, no torso.
2. TORSO plus pelvis ONLY, collar, cream shirt center, dark forest-green sleeveless waistcoat, brown diagonal baldric, belt and burgundy waist sash, cropped at the leg sockets; absolutely no head, arms or legs attached.
3. ONE upper ARM, cream rolled sleeve, from rounded shoulder pivot to elbow, hanging vertically straight. No torso or hand.
4. ONE FOREARM with brown wrist cuff and relaxed hand, elbow at top, fingers down; no sleeve.
5. ONE THIGH in dark charcoal trousers, hip joint at top and knee joint at bottom, straight down. No boot.
6. ONE LOWER LEG wearing tall dark brown leather boot, knee at top and sole at bottom, straight down. Toe direction agrees with row direction. No thigh.
7. ONE complete sheathed SWORD, gold crossguard/pommel and dark leather scabbard, hilt at top, tip at bottom, perfectly vertical, no belt or body.
8. ONE narrow hanging burgundy cloth sash tail.
All pieces are EMPTY COSTUME / CHARACTER SPRITE CUTOUTS for animation, clean rounded overlapping ends at limb joints. Not gore, not an exploded anatomical drawing.
Elías: young adult blond man, green eyes, dark-green vest, offwhite rolled sleeves, leather belts, wine-red sash, charcoal trousers, brown knee boots; no cape, no armor, no drawn sword.
Style: polished hand-pixeled 16-bit JRPG, crisp large square pixel clusters, dark brown one-pixel outlines, restrained 32-color earthy palette, light from upper left. Match the existing sprites' level of detail. Proportions for a final 58-pixel-tall character: head 15 px high, torso/pelvis 20 px, upper arm 10 px, forearm/hand 10 px, thigh 11 px, shin/boot 14 px, sheath 23 px. Enlarge the tiny logical parts consistently within the atlas for clear extraction; do not equalize every part's height. Each source part must preserve its proper relative size. Transparent background and clear empty gaps between all parts.
